ai_summary: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited has completed its amalgamation with Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited, issuing 1,51,90,373 new equity shares to the former's eligible shareholders as part of the scheme. This corporate action significantly increases the company's paid-up equity share capital by approximately 4.79%, resulting in dilution for existing shareholders but marking a key step in integrating the two entities. No immediate red flags are present, as this filing confirms the execution of a previously announced merger plan.
